Yesterday, I went with a friend who's a customer there. I introduced myself because I have a bully like him, and I decided to switch to them as my vet and buy his food there in their store. Normally, when you go and spend a lot of money on a particular food, knowing that consumption will be high since the breed naturally eats a lot, I didn't receive any discount as advertised. Even with the customer discount, the price is above market value, and above all, I wasn't entirely sure if it's good for my companion. Even so, offering a sample or something to ensure the customer leaves satisfied would be nice. I try to buy from local shops, but it's clear that you get better discounts online, and they even deliver to your door. It's a shame they don't treat customers better, especially those who will be spending money in the coming years.

Yesterday's purchase cost me €61.24. Luckily, everything is recorded on my phone because even the saleswoman couldn't give me a receipt. I just called to complain. My opinion on your reply, which I find out of place, is that you don't care and you're so arrogant. I'll attach the purchase receipt shortly, or better yet, I'll go pick up my mandatory purchase receipt this afternoon, and then I'll write my review with proof.

Stefano is an excellent veterinarian. He takes incredibly loving and dedicated care of my dogs, Dana and Kora, and always makes us feel comfortable. It's clear he loves his profession and has a special connection with animals. I'm so grateful for the attention and care he gives them every time we visit. I highly recommend him!

We took our dogs, Kora and Dana, to Stefano, and we couldn't be more grateful. From the very first moment, he treated them with warmth, professionalism, and genuine affection. It's clear he loves what he does and has a true calling.

He explained everything clearly, patiently answered our questions, and took the time to examine each of them carefully. Whether for routine checkups or more delicate situations, we always felt supported and in good hands.

Kora and Dana trust him completely, and that says it all for us. We wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone looking for a trustworthy veterinarian with genuine empathy for animals.

Thank you, Stefano, for taking such good care of our girls!

Exceptional care and a huge heart: Thank you, Stefano!

I take my pets to Stefano, and words can't express my gratitude for everything he's done for us. He's an incredibly professional, dedicated, and passionate veterinarian, but what truly sets him apart is his great humanity and genuine love for animals.

From the very first moment, he inspires confidence, patience, and impressive knowledge. He takes the time to explain each diagnosis clearly and without rushing, always seeking the best for our furry companions' well-being, in addition to following up with them. His treatment of animals is gentle, respectful, and full of affection. My pets adore him, and that says it all!

Furthermore, the clinic is impeccably maintained, and the team reflects his same dedication. I always feel heard and supported, even during difficult times.

Thank you, Stefano, for being so much more than a veterinarian: you are a true angel for our pets. I wholeheartedly recommend you to anyone looking for the best for their animals. Thank you so much for everything!

I finished the dog grooming course at the clinic, and I couldn't be happier. You are all wonderful people, especially Andy, who was my tutor. My experience with this clinic couldn't have been worse. I get the impression that all they do is make money and profit from the owners' vulnerability. In my case, I took my mother's cat, whom I'm now caring for because he was a stray and needed to finish his vaccinations. Imagine my shock when they told me they had to test him for feline leukemia and FIV after my mother had already paid almost 400 euros, supposedly for everything he needed. To my dismay, which I already found unacceptable, they told me it was a matter of protocol. A LIE. They took the cat away, and without me present, they supposedly performed the test because I never saw them administer it, nor did they show me the results. They did shave his paw and put gauze on it, though; I suppose that was all just for show. Fifteen minutes later, they brought me in, gave me the PRINTED test results without the actual test, and told me he had tested positive for leukemia. I couldn't believe it when the cat seemed fine. I was stunned because my mother had been sold almost 400 euros by the idea that the cat was healthy. The cat was now living with me and my other cat, so they had a double profit going on. They wanted to avoid paying for the vaccine (because they also sold my mother insurance to cover it), run more tests on the "supposedly" sick cat, and bring my cat along because they were sure she'd caught it. I flew into a rage because the whole thing seemed like a charade. I was terrified and haven't been back since. I took the cat to my vet, who is, by the way, a genius. We waited until now to retest him, and he came back negative. The test was done, of course, in my presence, along with the test that didn't leave the examination room. Therefore, the conclusion is that... They didn't give my dog ​​the test. They tricked me to keep squeezing money out of me and played with people's feelings. These people shouldn't be allowed to practice because they're shameless and awful. I advise you to run away because this clinic is the worst. Lack of professionalism, lack of empathy, lack of humanity. They take advantage of people and make a profit at the expense of animals and the owners' sensitivity. You can reply if you want, but what I'm writing is the truth, and I need people to know so this doesn't happen again. What happened hurts me deeply, and I need this to be known.

The clinic's reputation does not match the doctors' attitude and professionalism. The doctor was very rude, treated the cat very badly, answered questions erratically, and didn't listen to what was being said. The cat was stressed for a long time. They also refused to draw blood without anesthesia, even though another clinic did it in 10 minutes without anesthesia. Furthermore, the appointment cost double. I do not recommend visiting.
We've been customers for four years, and we've never experienced such poor service and treatment of the animals. The staff clearly doesn't know how to handle animals.
